item.title: Warmer weather, mainly dry this week; Some showers Wednesday
item.description: Monday afternoon may trend drier and sunnier, with high temperatures in the low 70s. Low clouds or fog develop Monday night. Meanwhile, temperatures remain milder with lows in the upper 40s to low 50s.

item.title: Judge rules 7-foot center Charles Bediako is no longer eligible to play for Alabama
item.description: Crimson Tide coach Nate Oats said Friday that Bediako will be allowed to remain on scholarship and work toward a college degree.
